problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization on R^d; nonconvex objectives are permitted. The gradient is continuously differentiable, and there exists a global lower bound m with f(x0)-m≤Δ. A minimizer need not exist.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: An independent fresh seed supplies an unbiased gradient g(x), with E‖g(x)-∇f(x)‖^p≤σg^p+αg^p‖∇f(x)‖^p. Queries do not expose the seed or permit its reuse.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedAffineHessianVector.lean: spec.Query, spec.admissible oracle answer, IID and gradient moment clauses

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Unbiased stochastic Hessian-vector products h(x,v), with E‖h(x,v)-∇²f(x)v‖^q≤(σh^q+αh^q‖∇f(x)‖^q)‖v‖^q. Each query requests either one gradient or one Hessian-vector product; both consume the same fixed total oracle budget.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedAffineHessianVector.lean: spec.Query and spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace, Convergence

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: ‖∇²f(x)‖op≤L0+L1‖∇f(x)‖ everywhere, with L0,L1≥0; no Lipschitz Hessian assumption.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedAffineHessianVector.lean: spec.valid and spec.admissible Hessian norm clause

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: Separate exponents 1<p≤2 and 1<q≤2 control gradient and Hessian-vector central moments. Their scales may grow with the gradient norm through αg and αh; finite variance is not required when the corresponding exponent is below two. All noise coefficients are nonnegative.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Euclidean space R^d with its Euclidean norm.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Oracle seeds are independent and identically distributed across calls. All Params, including dimension, initial point, accuracy, moment exponents, smoothness and noise bounds, and Δ, are public; f and the oracle distributions are hidden.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: Output is a measurable point X in R^d with integrable ‖∇f(X)‖ and E‖∇f(X)‖≤ε, ε>0.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Expectation includes algorithm randomness and the independent oracle sequence; execution uses a fixed upper budget counting all gradient and Hessian-vector calls.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Combines generalized smoothness with separate heavy-tail exponents and gradient-dependent moment scales for independent stochastic gradient and Hessian-vector observations.
